root_cause.text: The size calculation for the NLMSG_DONE message in nfulnl_log_packet used nla_total_size (attribute size accounting) instead of nlmsg_total_size (netlink message header size accounting), omitting the netlink message header and thus underestimating the required buffer size.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the line from `nla_total_size(sizeof(struct nfgenmsg))` to `nlmsg_total_size(sizeof(struct nfgenmsg))` with the comment "NLMSG_DONE needs to account for the netlink header size, not just the attribute size." The CVE description also explicitly states this oversight leads to a WARN splat and drop of the netlink message due to insufficient buffer space.
